filters.dateInvalid: The start date is after the end date.

deadline.late: Needs a Late Submission Request in the ETA portal

drawer.noProblems: Nothing is wrong with the data.

problem.ITEM_CODE: These products have no ETA item code:
problem.SELLER_DATA: The shop or branch data the ETA needs is missing:

BUYER_ID.business_tax_number: The business customer needs a name and a 9-digit tax number other than the shop's.

problem.BUYER_MISSING: The sale is 150,000 EGP or more and has no customer. The sale cannot be changed: contact support.
